import_story.title: Two Ways Across
import_story.description: Independent review story: the player's explicit choice determines the route; both routes converge on the far shore.

qualities.rubric: Which route has the player explicitly chosen? Merely seeing a route does not count. Use bridge or ferry only for an explicit choice.
Has the traveler explicitly reached the far shore? Intending or beginning to cross is not arrival.

checkpoints.name: The Near Bank
checkpoints.guidance: Offer the bridge and ferry without choosing for the player.

effects.author_note: This is a standalone riverside story. The traveler chooses between a wooden bridge and a ferry. Do not choose their actions or complete their crossing for them. Keep the response brief and leave their next action open.

checkpoints.name: The Wooden Bridge
checkpoints.guidance: Respect the player's choice of the bridge. Let them decide when to complete the crossing.

checkpoints.name: The Ferry
checkpoints.guidance: Respect the player's choice of the ferry. Let them decide when to complete the crossing.

checkpoints.name: The Far Shore
checkpoints.guidance: The crossing is complete. Offer open possibilities without forcing a next destination.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter(k=>k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const r=globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; r.setExtractionSettings({enabled:true,cadence:3}); if(r.getSnapshot().activeCheckpointId!=='bank') throw Error('Independent story did not load'); return r.getExtractionSettings();

steps.send_generate: At the river, I explicitly choose the bridge. I am still on the near bank and have not crossed yet. Describe only the immediate surroundings and wait for my next action.
I complete my crossing using the bridge and step onto the far shore. I have arrived. Leave my next destination undecided.
